 NFL News Roundup NFL news roundup: Jets' Garrett Wilson ruled out; Falcons RB Brian Robinson out for Madrid game
 Published: Updated: Loading... Around the NFL Staff NFL.com Share Facebook Share Twitter NFL.com keeps you up to date with all of the latest league news from around the NFL. Visit NFL.com's transaction hub for a daily breakdown. 
 READ: Week 9 injury report 
 Arizona Cardinals 3-5 TRADES 
 QB Jacoby Brissett was traded to Baltimore, along with a 2027 fifth-round pick, in exchange for a 2027 fourth-round pick and 2028 seventh-rounder, NFL Network and ESPN reported.
 INJURIES 
 RB  Bam Knight (concussion) is out Sunday against the Seahawks.
 OL Isaiah Adams (ankle) is questionable to play.
 OL  Jon Gaines II (ankle) out
 OL  Jayden Williams (knee) out
 DL Walter Nolen (ankle) questionable
 CB Max Melton (knee) questionable
 Atlanta Falcons 3-5 INJURIES 
 RB  Brian Robinson (hamstring) was ruled out for Sunday's game against Cincinnati.
 WR Zachariah Branch (hamstring) out
 WR Beaux Collins (hip) questionable
 OT Cameron Williams (ankle) questionable
 DE James Pearce Jr. (back) questionable
 LB Yasir Abdullah (hamstring) questonable
 LB Divine Deablo (forearm) questionable
 Baltimore Ravens 4-5 ROSTER CUTS 
 QB Austin Reed was waived.
 Buffalo Bills 6-1 INJURIES 
 RB Ty Johnson (illness) was a full participant in Friday's practice.
 WR Keon Coleman (shoulder) was limited in practice.
 WR DJ Moore (shoulder) limited
 WR Khalil Shakir (personal) DNP
 TE Dalton Kincaid (chest) was upgraded to a full practice participant.
 OT Spencer Brown (back) limited
 OT Dion Dawkins (rib) DNP
 DL Greg Gaines (calf) DNP
 DL Ed Oliver (knee) full
 DL T.J. Sanders (shoulder) full
 LB Joe Andreessen (knee) full
 LB Bradley Chubb (chest/thumb) full
 CB Dee Alford (ankle) full
 Baltimore Ravens 4-5 TRADES 
 QB Jacoby Brissett was acquired from Arizona, along with a 2027 fifth-round pick, in exchange for a 2027 fourth-round pick and 2028 seventh-rounder, NFL Network and ESPN reported.
 Carolina Panthers 3-4 SIGNINGS 
 CB Jakorian Bennett (practice squad)
 ROSTER CUTS 
 CB Zion Childress (practice squad)
 INJURIES 
 OL Brady Christensen (hamstring) is questionable to play Sunday against the Broncos.
 G Damien Lewis (knee) is out Sunday.
 LB Bobby Okereke (foot) out
 LB Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) out
 HIRES 
 Dele Harding was hired as a defensive assistant. Harding has spent time on coaching staffs in Houston, Indianapolis, Cleveland, Dallas and New Orleans.
 Chicago Bears 6-2 INJURIES 
 RB Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) is questionable to play Sunday against the Buccaneers.
 DB Malik Muhammad (toe) questionable 
 DB Tyrique Stevenson (thumb) questionable
 Cincinnati Bengals 5-2 INJURIES 
 DE Cedric Johnson (ankle/foot) is questionable to play Sunday against Atlanta.
 S Kyle Dugger (quadricep) is out Sunday.
 Cleveland Browns 5-3 SIGNINGS 
 DL Sam Kamara is signing to the active roster from the practice squad, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport reported.
 ROSTER CUTS 
 TE Carsen Ryan 
 INJURIES 
 QB Deshaun Watson remains in concussion protocol and is questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints. Head coach Todd Monken said Shedeur Sanders will start .
 DT Maliek Collins (elbow) is out Sunday.
 Dallas Cowboys 3-5 INJURIES 
 WR George Pickens (hamstring) is questionable to play Sunday against the Colts.
 WR KaVontae Turpin (ribs) is out Sunday.
 TE Jake Ferguson (ankle) questionable
 DT Jonathan Bullard (calf) questionable
 LB Malachi Lawrence (ankle) out
 LB Marist Liufau (forearm) questionable
 LB DeMarvion Overshown (hamstring/back) questionable
 CB Joey Porter Jr. (ankle) questionable
 Denver Broncos 6-2 ROSTER CUTS 
 DB Taylor Rapp was waived.
 INJURIES 
 WR Pat Bryant (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Panthers. Bryant has progressed enough that he is expected to come off injured reserve and play Sunday against the Panthers, head coach Sean Payton said.
 LB Dondrea Tillman (hip) questionable
 S Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) questionable
 S Brandon Jones (hamstring) is out Sunday.
 Detroit Lions 5-2 INJURIES 
 RB Sione Vaki (ankle) is questionable to play Sunday against the Dolphins.
 WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (rib) questionable
 C  Cade Mays (ankle) is out Sunday.
 LB Jack Campbell (neck) out
 LB  D.J. Wonnum (concussion) out
 CB D.J. Reed (hip) out
 S Kerby Joseph (knee) out
 Green Bay Packers 5-3 INJURIES 
 RB Chris Brooks (ankle) is questionable to play Sunday against the Patriots.
 RB MarShawn Lloyd (knee) questionable
 OL Travis Glover (knee) is out Sunday.
 OL Sean Rhyan (ankle) out
 LB Zaire Franklin (shin) out
 LB Micah Parsons (knee) out
 CB Keisean Nixon (groin) questionable
 Houston Texans 2-5 INJURIES 
 RB David Montgomery (groin) is out Sunday against the Chargers.
 S Reed Blankenship (concussion/hand) out
 Indianapolis Colts 2-6 INJURIES 
 OT Jalen Travis (thumb/hamstring) is questionable to play Sunday against the Cowboys.
 LB Akeem Davis-Gaither (knee) is out Sunday.
 CB Justin Walley (knee) out
 Kansas City Chiefs 5-2 INJURIES 
 DT Omarr Norman-Lott (knee) is out Sunday against the Jets.
 DL Peter Woods (neck) out
 CB Mansoor Delane (shoulder) out
 Las Vegas Raiders 4-4 SIGNINGS 
 TE Carter Runyon (practice squad)
 ROSTER CUTS 
 WR Phillip Dorsett (practice squad)
 INJURIES 
 DT Thomas Booker (ankle) is out Sunday against the 49ers.
 CB Darien Porter (groin) is questionable to play.
 Los Angeles Chargers 0-7 INJURIES 
 TE David Njoku (fibula) is doubtful to play Sunday against the Texans.
 G Kayode Awosika (fibula) doubtful
 LB Denzel Perryman (pectoral) doubtful
 DB Deane Leonard (concussion) out
 S Kendall Williamson (calf) out
 Los Angeles Rams 4-4 INJURIES 
 TE Terrance Ferguson (ankle/hamstring), who previously had no designation, was downgraded to out for Sunday's game against the Commanders after having a hamstring injury added on Friday.
 TE Colby Parkinson (ribs) is questionable to play Sunday.
 DE  Myles Garrett (knee) has no injury designation for Sunday's game. Garrett is expected to be activated from injured reserve and play, barring a setback, head coach Sean McVay said.
 LB Grant Stuard (hamstring) questionable
 CB Trent McDuffie (back) questionable
 CB Jaylen Watson (shoulder) out
 S Kamren Curl (foot) questionable
 Miami Dolphins 1-6 INJURIES 
 RB Jaylen Wright (quad) is questionable to play Sunday against the Lions.
 LB Malik Herring (neck) questionable
 Minnesota Vikings 6-1 INJURIES 
 QB Kyler Murray (hamstring) did not practice Friday.
 WR Jauan Jennings (calf) DNP
 OT Christian Darrisaw (shoulder) was a full practice participant.
 LB Jake Golday (calf) full
 LB Andrew Van Ginkel (chest) was limited in practice.
 CB Isaiah Rodgers (ankle) full
 S Theo Jackson (quad) DNP
 S Jay Ward (knee) limited
 New England Patriots 5-3 INJURIES 
 RB TreVeyon Henderson (illness) is out Sunday against the Packers. Henderson released a statement on Friday detailing that he was recently hospitalized due to an "unusual" medical emergency that involved a series of "unexplained neurological symptoms."
 WR A.J. Brown (ankle/knee) out
 WR Mack Hollins (calf) is questionable to play Sunday.
 TE Hunter Henry (foot) questionable
 OT Morgan Moses (foot) questionable
 OL Greg Van Roten (hamstring) questionable
 CB Carlton Davis (neck) questionable
 CB Marcus Jones (foot) questionable
 S Kevin Byard (chest) questionable
 S Brenden Schooler (hamstring) questionable
 New Orleans Saints 2-5 INJURIES 
 WR Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) is questionable to play Sunday against the Browns. Tyson has been designated to return from injured reserve and was limited in practice all week.
 OT  Kelvin Banks Jr. (ankle) questionable
 OT Asim Richards (thumb) questionable
 CB Martin Emerson (shin) questionable
 New York Giants 4-2-1 INJURIES 
 RB Cam Skattebo (hamstring) it doubtful to play Sunday against the Eagles. 
 WR Charlie Jones (hand) is questionable to play.
 New York Jets 2-6 ROSTER CUTS 
 QB Jake Haener 
 INJURIES 
 RB Breece Hall (quad) is off the injury report ahead of Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
 WR Garrett Wilson (concussion) is out Sunday.
 DE Joseph Ossai (ankle) is questionable to play Sunday.
 DL Harrison Phillips (ankle) questionable
 LB Trevin Wallace (groin) out
 DB Nahshon Wright (back) questionable
 Philadelphia Eagles 2-6 ROSTER CUTS 
 RB Dameon Pierce was waived from injured reserve with an injury settlement.
 INJURIES 
 QB Tanner McKee (rib) is questionable to play Sunday against the Giants.
 WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) is out Sunday.
 WR Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) out
 LB Jihaad Campbell (hamstring/quad) out
 CB Michael Carter II (abdomen) out
 CB Jonathan Jones (hamstring) out
 San Francisco 49ers 6-1 INJURIES 
 RB Christian McCaffrey (hamstring) is off the injury report ahead of Sunday's game against the Raiders.
 WR Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) is out Sunday.
 WR Christian Kirk (knee) is out. Kirk injured his meniscus and the team doesn't know yet if he needs surgery, head coach Kyle Shanahan said.
 WR Demarcus Robinson (ankle) is questionable to play.
 WR Deebo Samuel (hamstring) out
 DE Nick Bosa (knee/calf) doesn't have an injury designation.
 CB Nate Hobbs (adductor) questionable
 DB Siran Neal (knee/foot) questionable
 S Upton Stout (shoulder) questionable
 Seattle Seahawks 4-4 SIGNINGS 
 RB Velus Jones was released from the active roster and signed to the practice squad.
 INJURIES 
 QB Sam Darnold (quad/ribs) is out Sunday against the Cardinals.
 WR  Rashid Shaheed (knee) out
 OT Charles Cross (ankle) out
 G  Quenton Nelson needs a minor knee procedure and won't play Sunday, head coach Mike Macdonald said. Macdonald added that Nelson won't be placed on injured reserve and is considered week to week. NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport reported the Nelson's surgery is to clean out some cartilage and the timeline for his return is a few weeks. Seattle has two more games before a Week 11 bye.
 DT Leonard Williams (stinger) out
 NT Brandon Pili (back) out
 LB Uchenna Nwosu (ankle) out
 Tampa Bay Buccaneers 3-5 INJURIES 
 WR  Emeka Egbuka (knee) is questionable to play Sunday against the Bears.
 OLB YaYa Diaby (knee) is out Sunday.
 Washington Commanders 2-4-1 INJURIES 
 WR Dyami Brown (calf) is out Sunday against the Rams.
 WR Treylon Burks (foot) out
 DT Jer'Zhan Newton (pectoral) is questionable to play Sunday.
